definitions.game: One CSV row is one game/set; rows are not filtered or deduplicated.
definitions.missing: Empty/whitespace cells and literal MISSING; N/A and NONE stay distinct.
definitions.proportions: Class count / all rows in the corresponding dataset or stage; rates are 0..1.
definitions.known_applicable_proportions: Exclude MISSING, N/A and invalid labels; retain NONE and TIE where valid.
definitions.stage_difference: Playoff minus Regular Season in percentage points, using games.csv stages, not split filenames.
definitions.appearances: Counts over the ten player or champion slots. Duplicate tokens are flagged, not removed.
definitions.vocabulary: Observed names in train/test CSV slots, not vocabulary JSON IDs; no alias merging or UNK insertion.
definitions.undefined_rate: JSON null / console -- when the denominator is zero.
